# Stan pkgdown Configuration

**Do not use this theme in a non-Stan package.**

Styling for Stan sites built with pkgdown, built in the vein of
[stan-dev/quarto-config](https://github.com/stan-dev/quarto-config).

See the [vignettes](https://mc-stan.org/pkgdown-config/articles/) for
setup instructions; for any further concerns or help, open an issue
and/or ping `@Visruth` on the Stan Slack.

[Demo](https://mc-stan.org/pkgdown-config/)

# Package index

## All functions

- [`build_site()`](https://mc-stan.org/pkgdown-config/pr/18/reference/build_site.md)
  : Build a Stan pkgdown site
- [`roadmap()`](https://mc-stan.org/pkgdown-config/pr/18/reference/roadmap.md)
  : Print the roadmap
- [`roadmap_override()`](https://mc-stan.org/pkgdown-config/pr/18/reference/roadmap_override.md)
  : Navbar override for the roadmap
- [`use_pkgdown_gha()`](https://mc-stan.org/pkgdown-config/pr/18/reference/use_pkgdown_gha.md)
  : Copy the Stan pkgdown GitHub Action
- [`use_roadmap()`](https://mc-stan.org/pkgdown-config/pr/18/reference/use_roadmap.md)
  : Write the roadmap article
